about: SDK 19's screens in the game's own UI: an overlay from a XAML file of the mod in the game's styles, its text set every second, a click handler set, the refusals; a menu screen on the game's menu presenter opened, a second refused, closed by the mod and opened again; on the ship and in a mission (tests/in-game/README.md).
